title: Smoke but no flame at DARPA and AFRL Wright-Patterson

tellings.quote: yesterday there's a lot of smoke but no flame that I personally observed at DARPA or the afrl experience when I was assigned at R Patterson for three years

plain: A scientist named John Blitch says that in his years at DARPA, the Pentagon's agency for advanced research, and at the Air Force Research Laboratory at Wright-Patterson Air Force Base in Ohio, he found lots of hints about UFOs but no hard proof. He served three years at Wright-Patterson and tells Michels there was "a lot of smoke but no flame that I personally observed." Coming from an insider who also says a being abducted him, it means the rumours reached those places but he never saw what was behind them.
